entities.description: A character in the play, addressed as Augustin and Gus, who is a dean.

entities.description: A character in the play who speaks to the Dean.

entities.description: A person mentioned as someone who will lend money for the Spire.
entities.name: George Tidd

entities.name: the Spire

entities.description: A horse called Deception, used metaphorically.
entities.name: Deception

relations.description: Georgiana refers to the Dean as her brother Gus.
relations.evidence_quote: My brother Gus doesn't want us to be merry at his expense.

relations.description: Georgiana states that George Tidd will lend money for the Spire.
relations.evidence_quote: George Tidd will lend you that thousand for the poor, innocent old Spire.

relations.description: George Tidd will lend money for the Spire.
relations.evidence_quote: George Tidd will lend you that thousand for the poor, innocent old Spire.

relations.description: Georgiana says the Dean has been riding the horse called Deception hardest.
relations.evidence_quote: Shall I tell you who has been riding the horse hardest? THE DEAN. Who? GEORGIANA. The Dean.
